Subject: [UAI] ICAPS 2007: CALL FOR PARTICIPATION


[Apologies for cross postings]

                                CALL FOR PARTICIPATION

        The International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling
                                    ICAPS 2007
                         Providence, Rhode Island, USA
                              September 22--26, 2007
                           icaps07.icaps-conference.org

The technical program of the 17th International Conference on Automated
Planning & Scheduling (ICAPS-07) has been completed and we warmly invite
everyone working in planning, scheduling and related areas to participate.

In 2007, for the first time, ICAPS is co-located with the Constraint 
Programming (CP)
conference. In addition, ICAPS has reached out to the machine learning 
and model-based
reasoning communities to strengthen links between planning and 
scheduling and these
related areas. The 2nd International Competition on Knowledge 
Engineering for Planning
and Scheduling (ICKEPS) is also co-located with the conference.

The technical sessions are complemented by a varied and lively program 
of tutorials
and  workshops, a doctoral consortium, and demonstrations of planning 
and scheduling
systems. There are technical sessions and invited talks held jointly 
between ICAPS and CP,
chosen to promote areas of mutual interest and to encourage 
cross-fertilisation.

The preliminary program details and registration information are available
on the conference Web site. The early registration deadline is July 23rd.

We very much look forward to seeing you in Providence in September.
